headline: South Asia: Iraq PM hails new era of 'sovereignty' after US-led coalition exit
script:
Good afternoon. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- South Asia: Iraq PM hails new era of 'sovereignty' after US-led coalition exit.
- Asia: Russia sends nuclear warning to Nato over its Kaliningrad enclave.
- India: Russian strikes kill 7 in Kyiv; weak air defence keeps Ukraine under pressure.

Full breakdown follows.

NORTH AMERICA
United States - bottom line: First elements of USS Abraham Lincoln strike group return home.
- Military Times, 2 hours ago: First elements of USS Abraham Lincoln strike group return home.
The first ship within the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group, the USS Frank E. Petersen Jr., has returned home after its 10-month-long deployment.
- Military Times, 19 hours ago: US Navy taps 3 firms to build MUSVs for around $40M per vessel.
The U.S. Navy announced Tuesday that it is awarding contracts to three defense companies for the production of 30 medium unmanned surface vessels.
Central America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.
The Caribbean: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

SOUTH AMERICA
South America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

- Ukrainska Pravda, 6 hours ago: Russian forces strike Kramatorsk with guided bombs: three injured, social welfare office destroyed – photos.
Russian guided bomb attacks on Kramatorsk have injured three people and destroyed the city's Labour and Social Protection Department building.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 4 hours ago: Russian attack on Dnipro kills 33-year-old man.
A 33-year-old security guard was killed after Russian forces struck Dnipro, damaging local businesses and setting a house on fire
- Ukrainska Pravda, one hour ago: Russian drone crashes into playground in Kyiv without detonating – photos, video.
A Russian Geran-4 attack drone crashed into a playground in Kyiv's Obolon district on the afternoon of 30 September but failed to detonate.

- AllAfrica - Conflict, 2 hours ago: Ethiopia: Tensions Return to Tigray - Fears of a New Civil War.

Concern is also mounting over the formation of a new alliance of armed groups that has declared its intention to overthrow the government of Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed.

- AllAfrica - Southern Africa, 5 hours ago: South Africa: SAWS Warns of Heavy Rain, Severe Thunderstorms and Hail.
[SAnews.gov.za] The South African Weather Service (SAWS) has warned of severe thunderstorms accompanied by heavy downpours, strong damaging winds, hail and excessive lightning in Gauteng, central to eastern parts of North West, and central to western parts of Limpopo on Wednesday.

ASIA
South Asia - bottom line: Iraq PM hails new era of 'sovereignty' after US-led coalition exit.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 6 hours ago: Iraq PM hails new era of 'sovereignty' after US-led coalition exit.
A US-led coalition deployed in Iraq more than a decade ago to fight militants concluded its mission on Wednesday, a move celebrated by the country’s leaders. Coalition troops were deployed to Iraq and Syria in 2014 to fight the Islamic State group, which had seized large swathes of territory, committing massacres and forcing thousands of women and children into slavery. The group was defeated in Iraq in 2017 and in Syria in 2019, but coalition forces stayed on to battle the group’s remnants.

The advisory emphasized that this path could expose individuals to significant dangers. Continuous engagement with Russia is ongoing to ensure the safety of affected Indian nationals. Citizens are urged to verify job offers and avoid unregistered agents.
